title: Meeting slot finder
prompt:
Schedule meetings for four people (ann, bob, cat and dan) on one day. Times are written `HH:MM` on a 24-hour clock. Everyone is available only from 09:00 to 17:00, and not during their busy periods. A period `S-E` covers the time from S up to E, so something else may start exactly at E or end exactly at S. The busy periods are:
- ann: 09:00-10:30, 12:00-13:00, 15:45-17:00
- bob: 09:30-11:15, 13:00-14:00
- cat: 11:00-12:15, 14:30-15:15
- dan: 10:00-10:45, 13:30-16:00
Process the requests listed at the end in order. A request `NAMES DURATION` (NAMES are names joined by `+`) asks for the earliest meeting of DURATION minutes for all those people. The meeting must start at a time whose minutes are 00, 15, 30 or 45, lie completely within 09:00 to 17:00, and overlap no busy period of any of those people. If there is one, print `NAMES: S-E` and add the meeting to the busy periods of each of those people; otherwise print `NAMES: no slot`.
After the requests, print for each person, in the order ann, bob, cat, dan, `NAME free: ` followed by the periods of the day in which that person is free, in time order and separated by `, `: each free period is as long as possible (periods that touch are one period) and written `S-E`. If the person has no free time, print `none` after `free: `.
Requests, in order: ann+bob 60; bob+cat+dan 30; ann+cat 45; ann+bob+cat+dan 30; dan 120; cat+dan 15; ann+bob 45; bob 120.
